title: AlphaDog Styles Unisex Polo Shirt for Adults - Dog Breed Line Art, Chest Emblem Print
desc:
Wear your best friend. Minimalist continuous line art of your dog's breed on a breathable pique polo: a small emblem portrait on the chest.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Style: pick your breed.
2. Color: pick the color.
3. Size: pick your size.

FABRIC AND FIT: JERZEES 443M pique polo, breathable cotton-blend pique, ribbed collar and three-button placket. Classic fit that runs true to size.

DETAILS
- Printed in the USA, made to order just for you.
- Finished with the AlphaDog Styles logo label.
- Production 2-5 business days, then 3-7 business days in transit within the US. Tracking included.

CARE
Machine wash cold, inside out, with similar colors. Tumble dry low. Do not iron or dry clean the print.
bullets: ORIGINAL DOG ART: minimalist line art of your dog's breed by AlphaDog Styles - pick your breed in the Style menu
DESIGN: Line Art with a small emblem portrait on the chest
FABRIC AND FIT: JERZEES 443M pique polo, breathable cotton-blend pique, ribbed collar and three-button placket. Classic fit that runs true to size
MADE TO ORDER IN THE USA: printed just for you, tracking included. Production 2-5 business days, then 3-7 business days in transit
PERFECT GIFT for dog moms, dog dads and every dog lover. Finished with the AlphaDog Styles logo label
